storyline.label: Reasoning Latent
storyline.latest_title: [AINews] Behind Latent Space: Kill My SaaS, Jev & AI in 2026 | AIEi Shanghai

prior_narrative.tldr: An Oct 18 paper proposed hybrid agents that reason in latent space but act through text. A paper on Oct 27 then applied latent reasoning to multi-agent systems by storing reusable skills in compact external memory.
prior_narrative.whats_new: A new arXiv paper moves latent reasoning into continuous space for unified multimodal models, targeting weak language-based chain-of-thought in image tasks.
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: Latent reasoning aims to cut inference cost by keeping intermediate steps out of text, but it also makes those steps harder to inspect and log.

beats.headline: Hybrid agents think in latent space, act through text
beats.summary: Separates internal reasoning from the textual action interface.

beats.headline: SkillMem stores skills externally for latent multi-agent systems
beats.summary: Targets the mismatch between continuous reasoning and text-supplied skills.

beats.headline: Latent reasoning extends to unified multimodal models
beats.summary: Applies continuous-space reasoning to image understanding and generation.

open_questions: Do any of these papers report cost or latency savings against text chain-of-thought on the same tasks?
Is code or a model release available for the Hybrid Agents or SkillMem approaches?
prior_narrative.take_for_builders: These are unreplicated preprints; if you log reasoning traces for debugging, check what your tooling would lose before adopting latent-reasoning models.
